items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And, I'd see Andy off and on every time I'd go by the union. And, I'd get him on the phone and say Andy.

ctx.x: I liked him, and I liked his style. He had some beautiful fellows. Pha Terrell, Mary Lou Williams. I knew, I jammed with her. You know, sat down and had some talks with her, you know, during her jazz time.
And, I'd see Andy off and on every time I'd go by the union. And, I'd get him on the phone and say Andy. Do you know where I can find so and so? You know?
